about: The Money shape {minor: int, currency: ISO-4217} (T02) and the one converter from minor units to the provider's decimal string (system brief 5). Exponents: USD 2, EUR 2, JPY 0.

valid.note: signed amounts are valid inside the ledger; provider requests take positive amounts only

currency not in the supported set
